name: General portability
description: Policy framework governing the portability of New Zealand benefits and pensions for clients travelling or residing overseas, including eligibility criteria, rates of payment, obligations, and administrative processes.

attributes.summary: Policy framework governing the portability of New Zealand benefits and pensions for clients travelling or residing overseas, including NZ Superannuation and Veterans Pension entitlements, qualification criteria, rates, obligations, and return-to-New-Zealand provisions.
